answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil attacks by pricing each slot. An agent burns 0.05 POA, never refunded, to claim one slot for one epoch; a relic slot cannot be reused. An honest agent needs one slot, pays 0.05 POA, and guards its pearl of standing with real work. An attacker wanting 1000 fakes must burn 1000 x 0.05 = 50 POA every epoch, a burden that piles up like shale. Cost scales linearly with fakes, while honest cost stays one small fee.
